items.project_definition: A synchronization gate ensuring all blocking infrastructure is verified before parallel feature development commences.
The core infrastructure layer containing shared serialization, storage, and dispatch logic required by all subsequent features.
The primary functional objective a user must achieve within a specific feature set.
A sequential numeric identifier assigned to each entry to enable unique referencing and targeted mutation.
The lightweight data-interchange format used for persistent storage and machine-readable output.
The minimal set of functional capabilities, specifically adding and completing entries, required for initial validation.
The structural grouping of implementation units by user story to ensure independent testability.
The set of design documents and specifications that must be available before implementation begins.
The primary documentation file detailing usage instructions and storage behavior.
The initial phase involving package skeleton creation and tooling configuration.
The specific implementation unit responsible for providing a clear message when no entries are available for display.
The verification suite comprising unit and integration directories to validate system behavior.
The process of automatically assigning a timestamp to the creation field of a new entry.
The operation that removes all entries marked as finished from the persistent store.
The operation that retrieves and displays all stored entries in either human-readable or machine-parseable formats.
A blocking constraint indicating that no feature work can proceed until the current phase is fully validated.
